// The generator of emit-oracle.json (go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 v3.0.5). It is a .txt file, so the
// go tool and the linters skip it. To run it, copy it to main.go in an empty module with:
//   module yamloracle; go 1.26.0; require go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 v3.0.5
// and run: GOFLAGS=-mod=mod GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go run . > emit-oracle.json
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"go.yaml.in/yaml/v3"
)

func enc(v any, indent int) string {
	var b bytes.Buffer
	e := yaml.NewEncoder(&b)
	e.SetIndent(indent)
	if err := e.Encode(v); err != nil {
		return "ERR " + err.Error()
	}
	e.Close()
	return b.String()
}

func main() {
	out := map[string]any{}
	// strings marshaled as Node with tag !!str
	strs := []string{"a b\nc\n", " lead\nx", "x\n\n", "\n", "tab\tx\n", "trail \nx", "a\n b\nc", "😀", "\u0085x", "x\u2028y", "a\x01b", "-", "- a", "?", "? a", ":x", "a:", "a: b", "#a", "a #b", "a#b", "[a", "a]", "{", "a,b", "*a", "&a", "!a", "|", ">", "'", "\"", "%", "@", "`", "---", "...", "---a", "null", "Null", "~", "", "true", "yes", "on", "0x1F", "0o17", "0b1", "1_000", "1e3", ".5", "1.", "+1", "-0", "2026-10-13", "2026-1-2", "2026-10-13T10:00:00Z", "1:30", "80:80", "<<", "=", "a\\b", "é", "\u00a0x", "\ufeffx", " ", "x "}
	var nodes []string
	var folded []string
	var single []string
	var flow []string
	var maps []string
	for _, s := range strs {
		nodes = append(nodes, enc(&yaml.Node{Kind: yaml.ScalarNode, Tag: "!!str", Value: s}, 2))
		folded = append(folded, enc(&yaml.Node{Kind: yaml.ScalarNode, Tag: "!!str", Value: s, Style: yaml.FoldedStyle}, 2))
		single = append(single, enc(&yaml.Node{Kind: yaml.ScalarNode, Tag: "!!str", Value: s, Style: yaml.SingleQuotedStyle}, 2))
		flow = append(flow, enc(&yaml.Node{Kind: yaml.SequenceNode, Style: yaml.FlowStyle, Content: []*yaml.Node{{Kind: yaml.ScalarNode, Tag: "!!str", Value: s}}}, 2))
		maps = append(maps, enc(map[string]any{"k": s, s: 1}, 4))
	}
	out["strs"] = strs
	out["nodes"] = nodes
	out["folded"] = folded
	out["single"] = single
	out["flow"] = flow
	out["maps"] = maps
	floats := []float64{1, 0.5, 1e6, 1234567.5, 1e-5, 0.0001, 1e21, 123456789, -2.5e-7, 3.14159}
	var fs []string
	for _, f := range floats {
		fs = append(fs, enc(f, 4))
	}
	out["floats"] = floats
	out["float_out"] = fs
	keys := []string{"b", "a10", "a9", "a", "A", "_x", "1", "01", "x1y", "x01y", "x1", "é", "Z9", "a_b", "a-b", "a.b"}
	m := map[string]any{}
	for _, k := range keys {
		m[k] = 1
	}
	out["keys_out"] = enc(m, 4)
	// nested layouts
	var doc yaml.Node
	yaml.Unmarshal([]byte("a:\n- x\n- - y\n  - z\n- k: v\n  j:\n  - 1\n  m: {}\n- |\n  lit\nb: [1, {c: d}]\nc:\n  d:\n    e: [ ]\n"), &doc)
	out["layout2"] = enc(&doc, 2)
	out["layout4"] = enc(&doc, 4)
	out["layout3"] = enc(&doc, 3)
	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", " ")
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stdout, string(b))
}
